author: SegmentLinking
body:
#### PR description:

The LST pixel maps, built at run time by `RecoTracker/LSTGeometry`, connect TEDD disk 2 only beyond || = 2.3, but the cut was applied to signed , so every -z disk-2 module was dropped. On -z, a pLS could then never be linked to a T3 starting on disk 2, and no pT3 formed at 2.2 < - < 2.6: those tracks came out split into a pixel-only and an OT-only track that share no hit, which showed up as a duplicate-rate spike at   -2.4 that no hit-based duplicate cleaning can remove.

Commits:
1. **LSTGeometry: keep the -z TEDD disk 2 modules in the pixel maps**: mirror the cut on -z. The fix.
2. **LSTCore: keep the pLS superbin indices in range**: the  bin was truncated toward zero, so pLSs with -2.81 <  < -2.6 used the first  bin while those with 2.6 <  < 2.81 got no connections;  =  and dz  30 cm overflowed into the neighbouring superbin. The indices are now kept in range (for , commit 6 limits this to one bin beyond the range).
3. **LSTGeometry: add a `--geometry` option to `dumpLSTGeometry.py`**: to regenerate the RecoTracker-LSTCore files for a given geometry. Default unchanged.
4. **LSTGeometry: tell the -z side of disk 2 from the sign of z** (review): instead of the topology side. The maps do not change.
5. **LSTGeometry: share the superbin binning, and clamp both eta indices of the map windows** (review): the superbin ranges and the ,  and z bin helpers move to `RecoTracker/LSTGeometry/interface/Common.h`, for the maps and the pLSs. Both  indices of a map window are clamped, so a window beyond the range goes to the edge bin on either side and no negative value is cast to unsigned. The maps do not change with the current geometry.
6. **LSTCore: connect pLSs only up to one eta bin beyond the range** (review): pLSs with || < 2.81 use the edge bins on both sides, as -z did before; further out they stay unconnected, instead of all being tried against the edge-bin modules. The pLS bins now come from the same helpers as the maps.
7. **LSTGeometry: resolve the `dumpLSTGeometry.py` geometry once** (review).

#### PR validation:

CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000 + #52011 + #52015, D121, ttbar and QCD Pt 1.8-2.4 TeV, PU200, `hltGeneralTracks`.

- Maps (`DumpLSTGeometry`, pt 0.6 and 0.8): only the three `layer2_subdet4` maps change, only by adding -z entries. Disk 2 now has 96/96 modules and 36600/36600 connections on -z/+z, like disk 1. Commits 4-7 leave every map byte-identical.
- LST candidates (300 ttbar events, pT > 0.9), pT3 share -z/+z: || 2.35-2.40 34.1/51.8 %  52.7/51.8 %; 2.40-2.45 12.3/32.7 %  30.7/32.7 %. +z unchanged.
- MTV, 1000 events per sample, fix - base on the same events (paired errors):

| duplicate rate | ttbar | QCD |
|---|---|---|
| -2.5 <  < -2.3 | 3.08  1.79 % (-1.29  0.07) | 3.32  1.91 % (-1.40  0.07) |
| +2.3 <  < +2.5 | 1.72  1.72 % | 1.73  1.73 % |
| all  | 0.94  0.90 % | 0.95  0.91 % |

  Efficiency unchanged (all  and -2.5 <  < -2.3 within errors); fake rate at -2.5 <  < -2.3 slightly lower (-0.05  0.02 % ttbar). On CPU the +z side is bit-identical.
  Plots: https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/hltMTV_PR_LSTPixelMap_TTbarPU200/plots_hlt.html
- Timing: no significant change.
title: LST: restore the -z TEDD disk 2 pixel-map connections
